# Nordic Welfare Center (Nordens välfärdscenter)

> A Nordic Council of Ministers knowledge hub for welfare policy, public health, and social services research across the Nordic region.

The Nordic Welfare Center serves as a secretariat for regional cooperation on welfare, health equity, child welfare, elderly care, and disability services. It maintains multilingual content in Swedish, English, Finnish, Norwegian, and Danish, and coordinates research networks on critical social issues affecting Nordic countries.

## Key Topics

- Nordic welfare cooperation
- Public health
- Elderly care
- Child and youth welfare
- Disability services
- Social policy
- Welfare technology
- Health promotion
- Deafblindness
- Nordic countries
- Social services
- Regional collaboration
- Health equity
- Integration
- Disability rights

## Research & Publications

- [Publications Database](https://nordicwelfare.org/publikationer): Searchable publications database on Nordic welfare research
- [Child & Youth Welfare Publications](https://nordicwelfare.org/barnunga/publikationer): Publications archive for child and youth welfare research
- [Public Health Publications](https://nordicwelfare.org/folkhalsa/publikationer): Public health publications including Nordic Studies on Alcohol and Drugs

## Specialized Networks & Initiatives

- [Research Networks](https://nordicwelfare.org/natverk): Nordic research networks on welfare, disability, and deafblindness
- [Public Health Arena](https://nordicwelfare.org/folkhalsa): Nordic Public Health Arena secretariat focusing on health equity

## News & Events

- [News Feed](https://nordicwelfare.org/nyheter): News feed covering Nordic welfare topics and regional updates
- [Events Calendar](https://nordicwelfare.org/evenemang): Events calendar for Nordic welfare conferences and seminars
